items.title: Golden Hour Wash
items.goal: The iconic bread-and-butter Titanic look: a continuous sunset wash with ember texture and Vintage-only golden-white sweeps.

items.title: Golden Hour Pulse
items.goal: The musical sibling of Golden Hour: a sunset field rises in a clear double-heartbeat while 00 remains the continuous iconic wash.

items.title: Shimmer
items.goal: Elegant candlelight on moving water: fine traveling glints, a stable readable sign, and Jewelry as the golden lead.

items.title: Sparkle
items.goal: An elegant Celestial Chandelier: fixed constellation points ignite, form diamond cores, and decay over velvet-black negative space.

items.title: Sparkle Rain
items.goal: Descending luminous weather: droplets, long strand traces, and a slow rain-window Identity translate downward at separate rates.
